No email, private link, attachment, account, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.feeAmount: Each submission uses one credit. New artist accounts receive free starter credits; additional credit packs and monthly/yearly Unlimited plans are optional paid products.
newPlatforms.manualReviewReason: Current genre fit, age and authority, account creation, email verification, credit balance, MP3 and cover-art upload, metadata and artist context, agreement acceptance, non-exclusive worldwide royalty-free broadcast/promotion licence, rights and samples, Content ID, AI-origin disclosure, privacy/retention, optional payment and the final submission require human review.
newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from Red Devil Radio's official submission, artist, contact, submission-agreement, privacy, terms and public airplay pages. The current submission cycle accepts one original track in rock, country, hip-hop, indie rock, folk or alternative. Artists must create an account, verify email, upload one rights-cleared MP3 with cover art and context and spend one credit. Starter credits are free; extra packs and Unlimited plans are optional paid boundaries. The 11 June 2026 agreement keeps ownership with the artist but grants a non-exclusive worldwide royalty-free, technically sublicensable and removal-request-based licence to store, transcode, review, stream, publicly perform and promote approved tracks and supporting materials; no direct payment is promised. The platform records legal/account acceptance data including a hashed IP value and user agent. The contact page publishes Cloudflare-protected @reddevilradio.com mailboxes for support, artist review follow-up, press/partnerships and DMCA, but their local parts were not decoded and none replaces the account queue. Activity is evidenced by 24/7 streaming and public logged airplays through 29 June 2026. No account, email verification, credit, upload, agreement, CAPTCHA, payment or submission was used.

newPlatforms.notes: Passively verified on 2026-07-19 from WCOM's official submission, home, schedule and contact pages. WCOM is an all-volunteer station without a music director or central library; hosts select music independently. The station advises addressing recordings to a specific host or programme and states that its electronic form requires a host selection. The general new-release and coming-soon boxes receive only sporadic airplay. A physical package may be mailed to a named DJ at WCOM's Carrboro PO box. During passive inspection the form area rendered 'sorry, we can only accept one submission', so the live fields, upload mechanism, CAPTCHA and anti-spam controls were not exercised. stationmanager@wcomfm.org is first-party, syntactically valid and domain-aligned but is a general station contact, not a substitute for the host-specific route. Current activity is evidenced by the 2026 listener survey posted 9 July 2026, news and music posts in June 2026, a live schedule for 12–18 July 2026 and worldwide streaming. No form, host contact, email, package, login, CAPTCHA, donation, underwriting or submission was used.
